dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's up ahead?

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: It depends what you mean by "up ahead."

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: On one side, you have Aaru Village. As you can see, it is a village bordering the desert, and is home to us, the people of the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Though we are cut off by the Wall of Samiel, this is still a safe place that welcomes those who wish for rest.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Travel can be exhausting, and the desert is perilous. If you wish to stop for rest during your journey, this is the place to be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me more about yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: If you're looking to get some intel on the pretext of small talk, then you've come to the wrong person.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: In any case, Aaru Village has never been home to any secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: This is a place of exile for the Akademiya. Most people struggle to even make ends meet — never mind have any manner of strange thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Secondly, we, the desert people, consider this place our final home. We will defend it no matter the cost.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: So it doesn't matter what your reasons are — if you threaten the stability of the village, we, the Aaru Village guards, will take action against you without a second thought.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Good. Safe travels, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the other side?

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: That place is unfamiliar to me.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: When I was still working with the Eremites, I did go to Port Ormos several times, but all the work we got usually involved... kicking people while they were down.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: I decided it wasn't for me, so I left. I've never left the village since then.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: The only things I learned there that are worth mentioning are things I learned from the school of hard knocks.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: And well, now I use them to protect the village. That suits me just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: It's alright. I play pretty often in my downtime. Losing to me is no big deal.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Not bad! I'd say you're one of the best players out here in the desert!
